description: Unit test cases for the Contract doctype in ERPNext CRM module, testing contract status and fulfilment logic.

classes.name: TestContract
classes.description: Test suite for Contract doctype functionalities, including status and fulfilment checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing Contract table and creating a new contract document.

methods.name: test_validate_start_date_before_end_date
methods.description: Tests that start date cannot be after end date.

methods.name: test_unsigned_contract_status
methods.description: Checks default status for unsigned contract.

methods.name: test_active_signed_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies status when contract is signed and active.

methods.name: test_past_inactive_signed_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies status when signed contract has ended in the past.

methods.name: test_future_inactive_signed_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies status when signed contract is scheduled for future.

methods.name: test_contract_status_with_no_fulfilment_terms
methods.description: Checks fulfilment status when no fulfilment terms are set.

methods.name: test_unfulfilled_contract_status
methods.description: Checks fulfilment status when requirements are not fulfilled.

methods.name: test_fulfilled_contract_status
methods.description: Checks fulfilment status when all requirements are fulfilled.

methods.name: test_partially_fulfilled_contract_status
methods.description: Checks fulfilment status when some requirements are fulfilled.

methods.name: test_lapsed_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies status when contract has expired and fulfilment deadline passed.
